metrics_to_monitor_weekly: Audience retention graphs (where do viewers drop off?)
optimization_triggers: If CTR < 5%: Test new thumbnail style
If AVD < 40% on Shorts: Shorten hook time (get to reveal faster)
If AVD < 50% on Tutorials: Cut fluff, tighten pacing
If Search traffic < 10%: Improve SEO (title, description, tags)
If Subscriber conversion < 1%: Add stronger CTAs, improve end screens

month_3_onwards.strategy: Reach out to Instagram pet accounts with 10K-100K followers. Offer free portrait in exchange for Story/Reel featuring the result. Tag @pawcasso.atelier.
Partner with pet photography YouTubers. You film tutorial on their channel (photography tips), they link to Pawcasso. Win-win.
Pitch to pet-related podcasts. Share AI art story, offer discount code for listeners. Drives traffic + authority.

if_growth_slower_than_expected: Run YouTube Ads ($100/month to promote best-performing videos)
Launch giveaway: 'Free portrait to 10 lucky subscribers' (must like, comment, subscribe)
Cross-promote heavily from Instagram/TikTok Stories with direct YouTube links
if_growth_faster_than_expected: Hire video editor (Upwork, $20-30/hour) to scale production
Launch membership tier (YouTube memberships for exclusive styles/early access)
Expand to live streams ('AI Art Generation Live — Request Your Pet')
